product.description: Manual aprobat MEC 2019 Manualul de Informatică și TIC în limba maghiară pentru clasa a VII-a cuprinde patru unități de învățare care respectă domeniile și conținuturile din programă. The curriculum is designed as a journey into the "Digital World," ensuring comprehensive coverage of contemporary computing topics:

*   **Modern Programming Languages:** Students gain foundational knowledge in modern programming languages.
*   **Multimedia and Text Editing:** Practical lessons cover the effective use of text editors and multimedia applications, crucial for academic work today.
*   **Collaborative Tools:** The manual incorporates activities that teach working with collaborative applications, mirroring professional environments.
*   **Robotics Exploration:** A unique highlight is the dedicated chapter on robots. Here, robotics are presented not just as friendly concepts, but as intelligent and responsive systems, sparking deep interest in STEM fields.
